observations.body: The psalm recalls divine procession, trembling earth, rain, mountain rivalry, countless chariots, Sinai, sanctuary, ascent, gifts, and daily burden-bearing.
observations.label: The God of Sinai moves toward the sanctuary

observations.body: The God of Sinai moves toward the sanctuary belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Psalms 68:7–19 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Psalms 68:7–19 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The God of Sinai moves toward the sanctuary belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: The God of Sinai moves toward the sanctuary
